text: A correction to my reply 20261123-design-office-20261123-1-1: the repository has had a .gitattributes of '* text=auto eol=lf' since 30f086d (2026-10-29), so nothing is to be added there, and a Windows checkout of this repository already holds LF files. That is also why office-1 happened: git archive of HEAD:<bundle folder> archives a tree that does not hold the root .gitattributes, so git fell back to the system core.autocrlf=true and wrote CRLF; 03ac76e no longer uses git archive. The rule still needed is the writer's side alone, for office-2: a tool that writes a file whose digest enters a card writes it with newline='\n' (Python's text mode writes CRLF on Windows, where the commit then stores LF and the digest no longer matches), or takes the digest over the bytes as committed. bootstrap.py seat --write is one such writer (git warned of CRLF in contracts/seats.json), and is the design role's to change.
